fixture.databases: separate temporary private and bank SQLite databases under the acceptance temp root
fixture.task: one confirmed synthetic task with calendar and message reminders enabled
fixture.attachments: synthetic bytes with SHA-256 read-back only
fixture.operation: only a pre-existing simulated operation and its receipt; no real transaction or real delivery

faults.injection: raise once after private SQLite commit and before bank SQLite commit
faults.restart: construct a fresh ResearchWorkspace over the same temporary stores and perform a read
assertions: Before recovery, exactly one private task and one pending outbox event exist; bank reminder rows and bank recovery receipt are absent because the bank transaction rolled back.
Recovery applies the pending event under its original stable event id and event hash, then marks the outbox done only after the bank transaction commits.
After recovery, the task retains the same id and revision; exactly one linked calendar row, message row and bank recovery receipt exist.
Repeated workspace/task reads preserve the same identities and leave all row counts at one.

The operation id and original operation receipt are read back exactly; no new operation is submitted. If its outcome cannot be established, the task remains unknown/blocked and asks for reconciliation.

faults.injection: terminate a child process immediately after after_private_commit and before bank transaction exit; do not run Python cleanup handlers
faults.restart: start a fresh child/handler process with the same temporary database files and test identity, then perform a read
assertions: SQLite recovery preserves the committed private record and pending outbox while discarding the uncommitted bank transaction.
The same recovery and exact-once row-count assertions from PI-X06-COMMIT-EXCEPTION pass after process restart.
No real SMS, email, external calendar write, paid model, production service, or production account is used.

operation_receipt_subassertion.rule: Use the existing simulated operation idempotency key and immutable operation receipt. Query/read back unknown outcomes; never retry under a new operation id or claim success without receipt.

acceptance_rule: This is a subassertion of PI-X06, not a 25th case. Do not mark PI-X06 passed until both injected faults, fresh-process recovery, attachment byte/hash read-back, reminder exact-once counts, and operation receipt read-back pass on one frozen implementation version.
